title: Chesapeake's State of the City address set for March 5
text:
City Of Chesapeake Mayor - Dr. Richard W. "Rick" West | City Of Chesapeake website
City Of Chesapeake Mayor - Dr. Richard W. "Rick" West | City Of Chesapeake website
Chesapeake's annual State of the City address is scheduled for Wednesday, March 5, from noon to 2:00 p.m. The event will be held at the Chesapeake Conference Center located at 700 Conference Center Drive. For those unable to attend in person, Chesapeake Television will broadcast the event live. It can be viewed on Cox Channel 48, Verizon Channel 43, or online at www.CityOfChesapeake.net/LiveFeed.
The Hampton Roads Chamber is presenting this event. More information can be found on their website at www.hrchamber.com.
For further inquiries, the City of Chesapeake can be contacted at their office located at 306 Cedar Road, Chesapeake, VA 23322. They are available by phone at 757-382-2489.
